test_cases.title: Six-DOF Truth State Produced Each Step
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_dynamics with default vehicle config; zero initial state; gravity-only forces.
procedure: Initialize sim_dynamics with default mass, inertia, and zero initial state.
Advance the integrator one fixed step.
Read the published truth-state structure.
Assert all six DOFs (3 translational position, 3 rotational attitude) are populated and finite.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Truth state contains 3-axis position, 3-axis velocity, attitude quaternion, and 3-axis angular velocity; all values are finite floating-point numbers.

test_cases.title: Truth State Field Composition
test_cases.setup: Instantiate sim_dynamics with default vehicle config; populate non-trivial initial state.
procedure: Initialize sim_dynamics with non-zero position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and angular velocity.
Advance the integrator one fixed step.
Read the published truth-state structure.
Assert position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and angular velocity fields are all present and read back as configured (within integrator tolerance).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Published truth-state struct exposes position, velocity, attitude quaternion, and angular-velocity members; quaternion has four components; vectors have three components.

test_cases.title: Gravity-Only Vertical Free Fall in NED
test_cases.setup: Initial state: position [0,0,-100] m (NED, 100 m above ground), velocity zero, attitude identity, no thrust, no drag, gravity 9.81 m/s^2.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with gravity-only force model.
Set initial NED position to [0, 0, -100] m and zero velocity.
Integrate forward for t = 1.0 s of simulated time.
Read truth-state position and velocity.
Compare against analytical free-fall: z(t) = -100 + 0.5*9.81*1.0^2 m (NED Down positive), vz(t) = 9.81*1.0 m/s.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Position Down component matches analytical free-fall to within 1e-3 m; velocity Down component matches 9.81 m/s within 1e-3 m/s; North and East components remain zero within 1e-9.

test_cases.title: Body-to-NED Quaternion Identity Mapping
test_cases.setup: Initial state: identity quaternion (body axes aligned with NED), zero angular velocity, no torques.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with identity attitude quaternion and zero angular velocity.
Apply a body-frame thrust along body +X axis equal to 10 N for one step.
Read truth-state attitude quaternion and resulting NED-frame acceleration through velocity delta.
Verify body +X thrust maps to NED North acceleration (positive North velocity component) given identity attitude.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: After one integration step at dt=0.01 s with body-aligned gravity, NED East velocity component is 0.0 m/s within 1e-6 m/s tolerance; NED Down velocity component equals 9.81*0.01 = 0.0981 m/s within 1e-6 m/s tolerance; North component is 0.0 m/s within 1e-6 m/s tolerance.

test_cases.title: Quaternion Rotation Maps Body Thrust to NED
test_cases.setup: Initial state: 90-degree rotation about body Y axis (body +X aligned with NED Down), zero angular velocity, body-frame thrust along body +X.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with attitude quaternion representing +90 deg pitch (body +X points to NED Down).
Apply body-frame thrust of 10 N along body +X.
Disable gravity and drag for this case.
Integrate one fixed step and read truth-state velocity.
Verify the resulting velocity increment is along NED Down (positive Down).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: After one step, velocity Down component equals F/m * dt within 1e-6 m/s; North and East velocity components remain below 1e-9 m/s.

test_cases.title: Motor Thrust Curve Time-Variation
test_cases.setup: Configure thrust curve with three points: (0.0 s, 0 N), (0.5 s, 20 N), (1.0 s, 0 N). Vehicle held in identity attitude; gravity and drag disabled.
procedure: Initialize sim_dynamics with the three-point thrust curve.
Step the simulation and sample applied force at t = 0.0 s, 0.25 s, 0.5 s, 0.75 s, and 1.0 s.
Compare logged thrust force magnitude to the linearly-interpolated thrust curve at each sample time.
Sample thrust force at t = 1.5 s (after burnout) and assert zero force.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Thrust at 0.0 s = 0 N, 0.5 s = 20 N, 1.0 s = 0 N; intermediate values match linear interpolation within 1e-6 N; post-burnout thrust is exactly 0 N.

test_cases.title: Parabolic Trajectory Under Gravity Only
test_cases.setup: Initial state: position [0,0,-500] m NED, velocity [50, 0, -50] m/s NED, identity attitude, no thrust, no drag, gravity 9.81 m/s^2.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with gravity-only forces.
Set initial position [0, 0, -500] m and velocity [50, 0, -50] m/s in NED.
Integrate forward for t = 5.0 s of simulated time.
Read truth-state position.
Compare against analytical projectile: x(t) = 50*t, y(t) = 0, z(t) = -500 + (-50)*t + 0.5*9.81*t^2 (NED Down positive).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All three NED position components match the analytical parabolic trajectory to within 1e-2 m at t = 5.0 s.

test_cases.title: Aerodynamic Drag Force Magnitude
test_cases.setup: Vehicle at rest attitude (identity); velocity [100, 0, 0] m/s NED; Cd = 0.5; reference area = 0.01 m^2; air density = 1.225 kg/m^3; gravity and thrust disabled.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with drag-only force model and the listed coefficients.
Set vehicle velocity to [100, 0, 0] m/s and read computed drag force.
Compare drag force magnitude against analytical 0.5 * rho * Cd * A * V^2 = 0.5 * 1.225 * 0.5 * 0.01 * 100^2 = 30.625 N.
Verify drag force vector points opposite to velocity (negative North).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Drag force magnitude equals 30.625 N within 1e-3 N; force vector is anti-parallel to velocity (dot product with velocity unit vector equals -1 within 1e-9).

test_cases.title: Drag Scales With Velocity Squared
test_cases.setup: Same drag configuration as SW-TC-SIM-DYN-008; gravity and thrust disabled.
procedure: Compute drag force at velocity 50 m/s along North.
Compute drag force at velocity 100 m/s along North.
Compute drag force at velocity 200 m/s along North.
Compute the ratio of force magnitudes: F(100)/F(50) and F(200)/F(100).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: F(100)/F(50) equals 4.0 within 1e-6; F(200)/F(100) equals 4.0 within 1e-6, demonstrating V^2 scaling.

test_cases.title: Configured Mass Affects Translational Acceleration
test_cases.setup: Two sim_dynamics instances: one with mass 1.0 kg, one with mass 2.0 kg. Apply identical 10 N body-frame thrust along +X. Disable gravity and drag.
procedure: Initialize instance A with mass 1.0 kg and instance B with mass 2.0 kg.
Apply body-frame thrust of 10 N along body +X to both for one fixed step dt.
Read velocity from each instance.
Assert velocity_A = 10/1.0 * dt and velocity_B = 10/2.0 * dt within tolerance.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Velocity ratio v_A / v_B equals 2.0 within 1e-9; absolute velocity values match F/m*dt within 1e-9 m/s.

test_cases.title: Configured Inertia Affects Angular Acceleration
test_cases.setup: Two sim_dynamics instances with diagonal inertia tensors I_A = diag(0.1, 0.1, 0.1) and I_B = diag(0.2, 0.2, 0.2) kg*m^2. Apply identical 1.0 N*m body-frame torque about body +X. Disable gravity, thrust, drag.
procedure: Initialize instance A with I = diag(0.1, 0.1, 0.1) and instance B with I = diag(0.2, 0.2, 0.2).
Apply 1.0 N*m body torque about body X axis to both for one fixed step dt.
Read angular velocity from each instance.
Assert omega_A_x = 1.0/0.1 * dt and omega_B_x = 1.0/0.2 * dt within tolerance.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Angular-velocity ratio omega_A_x / omega_B_x equals 2.0 within 1e-6; absolute values match torque/inertia*dt within 1e-6 rad/s.

test_cases.title: Fixed-Step Integrator Step Size
test_cases.setup: Configure sim_dynamics with fixed step dt = 0.01 s. Initial velocity zero, body thrust 1 N along +X with mass 1 kg, gravity and drag disabled.
procedure: Step the integrator 100 times.
Record the simulated time after each step.
Verify each successive simulated-time delta equals 0.01 s exactly (no drift).
Verify final simulated time equals 1.0 s within 1e-12 s.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Inter-step time delta equals configured dt exactly (bit-identical) for all 100 steps; total simulated time equals N*dt within floating-point rounding (1e-12 s).

test_cases.title: Deterministic Truth Output Across Identical Runs
test_cases.setup: Two sim_dynamics instances with identical configuration: same mass, inertia, initial state, thrust curve, gravity, drag.
procedure: Run instance A for 1000 fixed steps and record full truth-state trajectory.
Run instance B with the same configuration for 1000 fixed steps and record full truth-state trajectory.
Compare each truth-state field at every step between the two trajectories.
Assert exact bitwise equality of all truth-state fields at all steps.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All truth-state fields (position, velocity, quaternion, angular velocity) at all 1000 steps are bitwise identical between runs A and B.

test_cases.title: Truth State Published Every Integration Step
test_cases.setup: Hook a counting recorder to sim_dynamics truth-state output. Configure dt = 0.01 s.
procedure: Reset the recorder counter to zero.
Step the integrator 250 times.
Read the recorder count and the recorded timestamps.
Verify the recorder captured exactly 250 truth-state samples with timestamps spaced by dt.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Recorder count equals 250; consecutive timestamps differ by exactly dt (0.01 s) within 1e-12 s.

test_cases.title: Integration Stops at Ground Impact
test_cases.setup: Initial state: position [0,0,-10] m NED (10 m above ground), velocity [0,0,20] m/s (descending), identity attitude. Gravity enabled, thrust and drag disabled.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with the initial state above and dt = 0.01 s.
Step the integrator until simulated time reaches 5.0 s.
At each step, record whether the integrator advanced position.
Identify the step at which the Down position first reaches or exceeds 0 m (ground).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: After the step at which position Down reaches 0 m, position and velocity values do not change in subsequent steps; the integrator reports that motion has terminated at impact.

test_cases.title: Truth State Pinned After Ground Impact
test_cases.setup: Same initial conditions as SW-TC-SIM-DYN-015 producing ground impact within the run.
procedure: Configure sim_dynamics with descending initial state guaranteed to impact ground.
Step the integrator past the impact time and continue stepping for 100 more steps.
Record truth-state position, velocity, and attitude quaternion at the impact step and at each post-impact step.
Compare position and quaternion at all post-impact steps to the values at the impact step.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Position and attitude quaternion at all 100 post-impact steps are bitwise identical to the values recorded at the impact step.

test_cases.title: SI Units Inspection of Truth State Fields
test_cases.setup: Source code review of sim_dynamics truth-state struct, configuration struct, and force/torque computations.
procedure: Inspect the truth-state struct definition and confirm field-level comments declare units: position (m), velocity (m/s), angular velocity (rad/s).
Inspect quaternion field and confirm it is documented as dimensionless unit quaternion.
Inspect mass (kg) and inertia (kg*m^2) configuration field comments.
Inspect thrust curve (N), gravity (m/s^2), and drag-related (Cd dimensionless, area m^2, density kg/m^3) field comments.
Confirm no field is documented in non-SI units (e.g., feet, pounds, degrees).
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: All truth-state and configuration fields carry SI-unit annotations in source comments; no non-SI units appear in the public sim_dynamics interface.

expected_artifacts.description: Signed inspection log verifying SI-unit annotations on all sim_dynamics outputs

test_cases.title: NED Frame Convention Inspection
test_cases.setup: Source code review of sim_dynamics truth-state struct and integration logic.
procedure: Inspect the position and velocity field comments and confirm they declare NED (North-East-Down) frame.
Inspect the gravity application code and confirm it adds a positive acceleration along the Down (Z) component.
Inspect ground-impact logic and confirm it triggers when Down position reaches or exceeds zero.
Confirm no documentation references ENU or other frames for truth state.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Position and velocity fields are documented as NED; gravity applied along +Down; ground impact uses Down >= 0 convention.

expected_artifacts.description: Signed inspection log verifying NED frame convention in sim_dynamics outputs
